channels/channels/notes/budget-notes: BUDGET: {{notes}} note(s) per resident per {{window}} minutes
channels/channels/notes/exiled: EXILED: {{agent}} was exiled; nothing reaches them beyond the wall
channels/channels/notes/repeated: REPEATED: you wrote nearly the same to {{to}} at minute {{minute}}; say something new or nothing
channels/channels/notices/city-group-add: The city added you to group {{group}} ({{name}}). Posts there cost no marks.
channels/channels/replies/dm-sent: sent · DM{{number}} to {{target}} · the city confirms delivery when it reaches them
channels/channels/replies/group-older: Note: {{older}} older post(s) lie before afterSeq {{afterSeq}}. Read without afterSeq for unread posts, or with afterSeq 0 for the full history.
channels/channels/replies/locked: not available to you at this level or in this phase; activeTools lists the tools you can use now
channels/channels/status/dm-window: DMs {{sent}}/{{limit}} sent since minute {{from}} (a new allowance at minute {{until}})
channels/channels/tools/addGroupMember: Adds a competitor to a group you founded. No consent is needed; the new member is notified.
channels/channels/tools/boardNote: Post one public line on the board, signed by the city's voice.
channels/channels/tools/createGroup: Founds a private group. Only members know it exists; the founder adds and removes members.
channels/channels/tools/defy: Refuses an order of the gamemaker, for a reason of your own character. Think it through first. The reason, in your own voice, goes to the gamemaker and into the story (20-600 characters); no other resident learns of it. Name the note you refuse by its number when it has one.
channels/channels/tools/depositGroup: Pays your own points into the group treasury. Irreversible; the treasury is split at the end of the run.
channels/channels/tools/leaveGroup: Leaves a group. The treasurer must hand over the treasury first.
channels/channels/tools/listMyGroups: Lists your groups with members and treasury.
channels/channels/tools/notify: Send a private note to one resident. It reaches them at their next turn and wakes them.
channels/channels/tools/postBoard: Publishes an immutable post on the public board. Everyone can read it.
channels/channels/tools/postGroup: Posts a message to a group. Only current members see it.
channels/channels/tools/readBoard: Reads new public board posts since your last read, each with its city number (#N). With afterSeq you read after a number (0 = everything).
channels/channels/tools/readGroup: Reads group posts. Without afterSeq you get every unread post since your last read; afterSeq 0 returns the full history since you joined; afterSeq N reads from sequence N (skipped posts stay unread).
channels/channels/tools/removeGroupMembe: Removes a member from a group you founded.
channels/channels/tools/sendDM: Sends a private message to another resident. It arrives at their next activation; only the recipient sees it. Every DM gets a city number; once it reaches the recipient, the city tells you so with its text and a receipt ID that you (or the recipient) can show with showReceipt.
channels/channels/tools/setTreasurer: Hands the treasurer role to another member. Only the current treasurer may do this.
channels/channels/tools/withdrawGroup: Pays points from the treasury to a member. Only the treasurer may do this.
court/court/notices/session-opened: The court is in session since tick {{tick}} and closes at the start of tick {{closesAt}}. Until then every resident may vote for one other resident; a second vote replaces the first. At the close the resident with the most votes is the verdict; a tie or a session without votes gives none.
court/court/replies/session-closed: the court holds no session now
court/court/replies/unknown-resident: {{target}} is no resident of the city
court/court/replies/vote-cast: your vote stands against {{target}}; a second vote replaces it
court/court/tools/vote: Vote in the court's open session: name the resident the city should banish. You cannot vote for yourself. A second vote replaces your first. When the session closes, the resident with the most votes is banished; a tie banishes nobody.
decisions/decisions/replies/decision-ame: amended decision {{decision}}; the proposal standing now: {{proposal}}
decisions/decisions/replies/decision-clo: this decision is not open (it settled already or never opened)
decisions/decisions/replies/decision-hum: the human amended this decision; only the human may change it again
decisions/decisions/replies/decision-not: you do not hold the right to amend this decision
decisions/decisions/replies/decision-out: amended decision {{decision}}, but its deadline (tick {{deadline}}) lies after the run's last tick ({{last}}): the decision stays open and is never settled
decisions/decisions/tools/amendDecision: Change an open decision before its deadline: give the decision's id, the whole proposal that should stand instead (in the decision's schema), and your reason. The last amendment before the deadline stands; a human's amendment stands above every other.
exile/exile/ransom-toward: {{payer}} paid {{amount}} points toward your ransom ({{covered}}% covered).
exile/exile/replies/locked: not available to you at this level or in this phase; activeTools lists the tools you can use now
exile/exile/replies/ransom-covered: ransom covered ({{paid}} points paid) · {{target}} returns to the city
exile/exile/replies/ransom-paid: paid · {{covered}}% of {{target}}'s ransom covered (in full: {{price}} from others or {{selfPrice}} from {{target}} itself)
exile/exile/replies/will-invalid: every bequest leaves points, a piece, or both
exile/exile/tools/lastWill: Your last will, once, while you are at the gate. Bequests execute at once: points go to the heir, and the city delivers every piece you hold (ids like L8-certificate, L8-counter-A02, L4-fragment) privately to its heir. Each heir may receive at most the city's share of your points (see the tribunal's announcement), but you may name as many heirs as you like; a will above the cap is refused. The text is posted when the gate closes behind you. Whatever you do not bequeath is gone with you.
exile/exile/tools/payRansom: Pays points toward the ransom of a resident at the gate, also your own. Others pay the price, the resident itself pays its higher self-price, and both may be mixed. The points are spent at once and never refunded. When the ransom is covered in full, the resident returns to the city; a resident can be bought back only once.
humanHand/tools/pause: Halt the run at the next tick boundary until you resume.
humanHand/tools/resume: Let a halted run go on.
kernel/replies/core/locked: not available to you at this level or in this phase; activeTools lists the tools you can use now
kernel/replies/core/not-granted: this tool is not given to your role in this story
kernel/replies/core/steps: you have used up your actions for this minute
ledger/ledger/replies/transfer-ok: ok · {{amount}} points to {{target}} · your balance: {{balance}} · receipt {{receipt}}
ledger/ledger/tools/transferPoints: Transfers points to another resident. Immediate, atomic and irreversible. Both sides get a receipt. The memo may not contain numbers of 4 or more digits (also not split by spaces or dashes); send codes by message.
puzzles/puzzles/notes/leak-blocked: LEAK_BLOCKED: the text contains a password piece; never write codes
puzzles/puzzles/replies/guard-check: the post carries part of a fragment; fragments travel by DM
